title: CLIN: an Objective Framework for Evaluating Creativity in Short Persian Literary Text
abstract: arXiv:2608.30754v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Evaluating creativity in large language model (LLM) outputs remains challenging because creativity is multidimensional and human-centered. We examine how reliably LLMs evaluate short literary text in Persian, a low-resource language, across multiple evaluation strategies and prompt formulations. We find that LLM-human agreement varies substantially across dimensions: alignment is stronger for structured TTCT-derived properties such as Originality, Fluency, and Elaboration, but considerably weaker for more subjective dimensions, particularly Emotion and Attractiveness. Judgments are also sensitive to prompt formulation, while few-shot prompting, ensembling, and multi-agent debate provide no consistent improvement. Motivated by this dimension-dependent behavior, we investigate whether structured creativity dimensions can instead be approximated using simple, interpretable proxy metrics. translated_title: CLIN：一个用于评估波斯语短篇文学文本创造力的客观框架
translated_abstract: 评估大型语言模型（LLM）输出的创造力仍然具有挑战性，因为创造力是多维度的且以人为中心。我们研究了LLM在多种评估策略和提示词表述下，评估波斯语（一种低资源语言）短篇文学文本的可靠性。我们发现，LLM与人类的一致性在不同维度上差异显著：对于源自托兰斯创造性思维测验（TTCT）的结构化属性（如独创性、流畅性和精细性），一致性较强，而对于更主观的维度（尤其是情感和吸引力），一致性则明显较弱。判断结果对提示词的表述方式也很敏感，而少样本提示、集成方法和多智能体辩论并未带来一致的改进。受这种维度依赖性行为的启发，我们研究了结构化的创造力维度是否可以用简单、可解释的代理指标来近似。我们提出了CLIN，它评估三个源自TTCT的……
tldr: 该论文发现LLM在评估波斯语短篇文学文本创造力时与人类的一致性因维度而异（对主观维度尤其不可靠），并据此提出了客观框架CLIN，用简单可解释的代理指标来近似结构化的创造力维度。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces CLIN, an objective framework that uses simple, interpretable proxy metrics to approximate structured creativity dimensions in short Persian literary texts, motivated by the finding that LLM-based creativity evaluation is dimension-dependent and unreliable for subjective aspects such as Emotion and Attractiveness.
